entities.summary: Sargis Sargsian is a former professional tennis player from Armenia. He reached career-high rankings of World No. 38 in singles and World No. 33 in doubles, winning one singles and two doubles titles on the ATP Tour. Sargsian finished 8 seasons in the top 100 ATP year-end rankings. Sargis Sargsian was a athletes & competitors from Yerevan (b. 1973-06-03, Yerevan).
